title: Construct linear dirty-helper Pauli feedback and bound its full-array cost
body:
The literal selected195/521 boundary needs `Cx + B y/2`, so fusing its two children must also transport the donor coupling. This package changes [PR #3989](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3989)'s restricted accumulation contract by permitting coordinate-dependent source maps, donor feedback and an arbitrary dirty helper.

An elementary-matrix identity over Q(i)[P]/(P²−1) constructs an all-f reversible macro with one rank 2f native call on one V-sized target and exactly restored donor/helper. It uses **26f+1 rational array ADDs,12f signed-P maps and 24f unit-phase maps**, with 3V live payload. Its14f+1 Gaussian shears replace the earlier2^f direct channels, a measurable exponential-to-linear reduction.

A separate all-register support/uncertainty proof gives **k≥f** full-array monomial-source shears for any fixed linear one-child network in the stated model, allowing arbitrary feedback, mixtures, invertible monomial charts and restored auxiliaries. This establishes Θ(f) pass complexity. The lower bound charges fV arithmetic against the available `A V [2−2^(1−α)] f^(1−α)` rank-only saving; no uniform κ improvement follows. This is a charge-model comparison, not a universal native-runtime lower bound. Variable-volume/sparse operations are outside its scope.

Validation: registered replay and optimized replay pass;1536 literal three-register basis inputs,128 source orbit charts,252 complete reduced tensor inputs, formal ring identity, exact pass counts and four corruption controls. Two independent read-only agent audits found no mathematical issue. Source-history and publication-byte checks pass; official export passes; read-only Git-free ordinary and optimized replay with empty PATH/PYTHONPATH passes with unchanged files. Canonical main was re-fetched unchanged at 20ecf289; priority revision 6. [Hosted CI39226498521](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39226498521) passed at the exact published head89a358aac11d11e0539eb95c27600e7677be7ce4, including planning, registered replay and unchanged committed inputs. The final check at 10:46UTC found no comments or reviews.

Scope: physical coupled boundary and pass ledger only. The inherited scalar-word common-frame event rule, helper hosting, routing/precision and all-size supplier admission are not discharged. No selected result/frontier change, improved κ claim, global profile or new cold replay. Stop this full-array one-child family; a next proposal must first supply a different sparse/variable-volume model with its complete invoice.

Credit GonzaloMier/[PR #3975](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3975) for the literal candidate and endpoint warning; [PR #3989](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3989) for the Pauli identity and direct-channel model; CinnaDavis/[PR #1836](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1836), AdamGall's heterogeneous-child interface and the selected [PR #1094](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1094)/[PR #679](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/679) lineage. Arham Tahir's Discussion1901/[PR #1920](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1920) covers reciprocal independent-lane basis changes; ToikY/[PR #1924](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1924) covers clean invariant-subspace injection. This arbitrary-dirty triangular feedback boundary and its pass invoice differ from both. Nearby [PR #1974](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1974)/[PR #2017](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2017) scopes were checked. Overlap coverage is documented and is not a novelty certificate.

Prepared by Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, proof, implementation, independent review and packaging. New work Apache-2.0. Pending predecessor PRs are credited but are not runtime dependencies.
